output.summary: A genus of tap-rooted perennial herbs native to temperate parts of the Northern Hemisphere. Its yellow-to-orange flower heads mature into round seed heads whose white, fluffy parachutes carry seeds on the wind; many species also form seeds without pollination. Leaves, stems, flowers and roots are edible, with greens eaten raw or cooked and roots roasted as a coffee substitute.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves, stems, flowers and roots are edible; greens may be eaten raw or cooked, while roasted roots can substitute for coffee.
